decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (Q01, 14029TAMIANWAY UNITD1-101, 14029TAMIANWAY UNITD1-102, 14029TAMIANWAY UNITD1-103, Acoustic Assessment Report ref. 7638/AAR revision 1 dated 6 March 2017 prepared by RBA Acoustics  and Letter from Tony Gallgher at Quod ref. Q70063 dated 15 March 2017. All received 16/03/2017.) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 2 - The site shall be used for B1(c), B2 or B8 and for no other purpose (including any other purpose in Class B of the Schedule to the Town and Country Planning (Use Classes) Order 1987, or in any provision equivalent to that Class in any statutory instrument revoking and re-enacting that Order with or without modification).

Condition : 3 - The use hereby permitted may operate between 00.00 to 00.00 Monday to Sunday and Bank Holidays. Between the hours of 23.00-07.00 Monday to Sunday and Bank Holidays, no manufacturing processes shall be carried out, the site and the sawing and dust extraction plant shall not be operated and there shall be no deliveries to the site.

Condition : 4 - Within 3 months of the date of this permission, the mitigation measures proposed in the approved noise assessment ref. Acoustic Assessment Report ref. 7638/AAR revision 1 dated 6 March 2017 prepared by RBA Acoustics shall be implemented on site and so maintained at all times thereafter.
Condition : 5 - The carrying out of any manufacturing, or the storage of bedroom and kitchen furniture and units or of parts, shall not take place outside of the premises hereby permitted.
description: Retrospective application for the change of use from Non-Residential Institution (Class D1) to General Industrial (Class B2) and the retention of existing plant equipment
